article.title: WTA與Hello Kitty首度聯推官方商品，總決賽設現場銷售
article.title_en: WTA and Hello Kitty’s first official merchandise collection heads to Finals fan village
article.summary: 首批商品以網球場景呈現Hello Kitty，計劃在11月8日至15日印第安韋爾斯總決賽現場發售。
article.summary_en: The tennis-themed collection is planned for on-site sale at the November 8–15 Finals in Indian Wells.
highlights: 系列包括T恤、運動衫與毛絨公仔。
WTA稱完整系列亦將於Sanrio網站發售。
highlights_en: Items include T-shirts, sweatshirts and a collectible plush.
WTA says the full range will also be offered on Sanrio’s website.
article.why: 賽事與角色品牌可用限期現場銷售帶動試穿和展示，再由網店承接未到場的球迷。
article.why_en: A sports event and character brand can use a limited on-site window for display and fitting, with online sales for remote fans.
article.next_step: 規劃聯乘時分開訂定現場及網店庫存、補貨和履約規則。
article.next_step_en: Set separate venue and online rules for inventory, restocks and fulfilment.
article.detail: 這是WTA與Hello Kitty首個官方商品系列。WTA公布在總決賽球迷區銷售，並安排Sanrio網站提供系列商品。WTA另預計於2027年春季開設專屬球迷網店，現階段屬計劃。不同渠道的發售時間、庫存及配送範圍仍應以各店為準。品牌團隊可參考這種安排，在活動現場和網店分開設計商品陳列及購買流程。
article.detail_en: This is the first official WTA and Hello Kitty collection. WTA announced fan-village sales and a Sanrio online range. Its own fan shop is expected in spring 2027. Check sale timing, stock and delivery by channel. Teams can plan separate merchandising and checkout flows for the venue and website.
